evidence.title: Meraki UI Components | Free Tailwind CSS Components

name: Meraki UI
summary: Free Tailwind CSS components with RTL support, dark mode and responsive layouts, plus free and paid landing page templates.
description: Copy-paste Tailwind CSS components organised into application UI and marketing groups: alerts, avatars, breadcrumbs, buttons, cards, dropdowns, forms, inputs, modals, navbars, sidebars, tables, tabs, tooltips, 404 pages, CTAs, contact, FAQs, features, footers, heroes, pricing and teams. Components are responsive, support right-to-left languages and ship with an elegant dark mode. A templates section adds landing pages and dashboards built with Alpine.js, Laravel Blade and Vue 3.
contains: 40 component pages under Application UI and Marketing
category counts: Inputs 13, Heros 11, Avatars 10, Cards 9, Skeleton 8, Pricing 7, Blog 6, Breadcrumbs 5, Forms 4
RTL language support and dark mode on every component
9 templates: free Vue 3 landing pages and paid dashboards and landing pages from $16 to $69
